en.role: President of the United Aircraft Corporation
en.quote: The first production Su-57 aircraft will be delivered to the Aerospace Forces this year.
en.head: The first production Su-57 was delivered in 2020.
en.body: United Aircraft Corporation says the first Su-57 from the initial production batch was delivered to the Defence Ministry in 2020. An aircraft intended for delivery at the end of 2019 crashed during a test flight. Delivery therefore followed the promised year.

osrc.t: United Aircraft Corporation, first Su-57 delivery
